'''Geth''' was a [[Science Research Droid]] modified by former Rebel [[General/Legends|general]] [[Reesen Jivrak]]. He used Geth to create [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] that would strengthen and enrage the docile [[deripor]]s of [[Ohratuu]] for use as mounts in hit-and-run attacks.
